To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MINERVA, our novel reinforcement learning based path-based method, is competitive with many current path-based methods on seven knowledge base completion datasets.

1) MINERVA outperforms all previous path-based methods on all seven datasets; 2) MINERVA achieves state-of-the-art performance on three datasets and competitive performance on the other four datasets; 3) MINERVA is the only method to achieve state-of-the-art results on the challenging WN18RR dataset, and 4) MINERVA performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on the FB15K-237 dataset.
